english.title: Care worker cause mentally disordered person to watch a sexual act - SOA 2003
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a care worker, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ROLE..), who was involved in the care of a person in a way which fell within section 42 of the Sexual Offences Act 2003, who had a mental disorder and who you knew or could reasonably be expected to have known had such a disorder, for the purpose of obtaining sexual gratification, intentionally caused

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

(C)_[to watch a third person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..),]_
(D)_[to look at an image of a person]_

engaging in a sexual activity
english.legislation: Contrary to section 41 of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 72 of, and Schedule 2 to, the Sexual Offences Act 2003 regarding the committing of this offence outside the UK by UK nationals / residents.
(ii) A person convicted of this offence is subject to notification and orders as provided by section 80 of the Act as follows:-
(a) where the offender was under 18 years of age where he is or has been sentenced in respect of the offence to imprisonment for a term of at least 12 months;
(b) in any other case, the offender, in respect of the offence or finding, is or has been sentenced to a term of imprisonment, detained in a hospital, or made the subject of a community sentence of at least 12 months. (Sch 3 paragraph 28).

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
